description.after: Whiz is the BrainOS commercial vacuum platform, retained separately from Whiz i and 2026 Whiz B/P/V. description.after: NAO6 is the programmable humanoid documented by Maxtronics as model H25600, with 25 DOF, 5.48 kg robot mass and 574×311×275 mm H×D×W. validation.initialValidationFindings: Offline refresh caught the initial Pepper+ slug without the required plus suffix; corrected before build. Existing Maxtronics profile explicitly bound to its own NAO7 project to prevent a duplicate generated profile. First selected browser run passed 14/16 and caught a missing date space in new NAO6/company prose. Corrected in primary records, refreshed exports, rebuilt and repeated affected checks. Scratch export assertions corrected to count repeated source references (five model rows and three company-product rows). A provisional browser run overlapped a rebuild and failed its search cases; discarded, then repeated after the final build completed (16/16). Final checks use corrected data.
validation.scope: 41 source attempts: 35 HTTP200, three transient DNS failures and three 404. Four PDFs contain 323 extracted pages; the 312-page Pepper+ manual was inspected only for selected setup/charging text on six pages. No visual PDF inspection or hidden password-gated manuals. Thirty-four selected browser cases including eight axe runs, not the full browser suite. Manufacturer statements are not independent testing or full historical coverage.
